name: Lamington
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Cut the sponge cake into your desired shapes (commonly 5–7 cm cubes).
Prepare a flat tray with an even layer of desiccated coconut shavings
Dip the sponge cake cubes into chocolate icing.
Immediately dip the coated cake into the coconut, or sprinkle the coconut on top.
Put aside to dry and set.

culture.text: A lamington is an Australian cake made from squares of butter cake or sponge cake coated in an outer layer of chocolate sauce and rolled in desiccated coconut. The thin mixture is absorbed into the outside of the sponge cake and left to set, giving the cake a distinctive texture. A common variation has a layer of cream or strawberry jam between two lamington halves.
